Darren Kirby | Maintenance | Halden & Pryce Lettings

- Bench on the printed sheet
- Darren saw a line about 40 m earlier

Which one do we use to log the time?

M

Hi all,

Keep going to the bench and stop your watch when you're level with the far end. That's the end nearest the gate. I went down this afternoon because I couldn't picture the line Darren was talking about. It's fresh paint on the path in front of the pump house and it runs straight across, which looks exactly like something we'd use for a finish. The park crew were still there and told me it's where the machine stops when they skim the path. They'll be doing the bit on the other side of the line next. For the trial you pass it and carry on to the same finish we've been using.

There's a bit of a dip after the bench. If you're waiting for someone else to finish, give yourself room to slow down first and go back along the grass. Last time we had someone standing in the dip trying to read six watch faces as people were still coming in.

Harriet

Harriet Lowe MCSP
Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

Bench it is. Thanks.

Regards Darren

Darren Kirby | Maintenance | Halden & Pryce Lettings
